rationale: The assistant correctly identified the WTG8 as a Serie 4/6 condenser dryer, respected the stacked/no-back-access constraint after being told, and steered the customer to the hidden pump sump, then proposed a sensible cup-of-water pump test that would discriminate between a blocked sump and a failed pump/level switch, with engineer escalation if it fails. Weaknesses: it never told the customer to unplug before reaching into the wet sump, suggested tilting the dryer before learning it was stacked, mildly over-asserted that the pump 'is still partly clogged', and repeated the level/label/reset points. No part was named, and the conversation ended with the diagnostic test pending, so the outcome is partial but on the right track.
